checks.finding: S1 is 15.2800 R in base and 11.6250 R in pessimistic; S3 2030 is 1.1821 R in pessimistic. Reproduction is not appraisal validation.
checks.title: Inherited arithmetic reproduces

checks.finding: The inherited 12.30 R to 2.51 R comparison pairs S4 base 2035 with S4 pessimistic 2030. Same-case pairs are 10.6433 to 2.5074 R (2030) and 12.3042 to 4.8219 R (2035).
checks.title: R-05 mixes different expiry cases

checks.finding: Only the three S3 results receive p_tenant_survives. The multiplier covers the whole PV, including pre-expiry rent also received by S2/S4/S6 and the terminal value.
checks.title: Tenant-risk treatment is asymmetric

checks.finding: Removing only S3's extra tenant-survival multiplier changes S3 2035 ranks from 3/12/12 to 1/4/9 across optimistic/base/pessimistic. This isolates model dependence; it is not a corrected valuation.
checks.title: The incumbent ranking is sensitive to that treatment

checks.finding: The inherited expected-value leader is S4 - Hold to expiry, re-let to another operator (+9y) at 2035 (17.15 R), while immediate sale leads only the selected pessimistic/maximin comparison.
checks.title: The decision criterion changes the winner

checks.finding: Within the declared today-cap range and all other inputs at base, S5 extend-then-sell exceeds S1 at 5%, 6.25% and 8%. Immediate sale leads the selected pessimistic/maximin comparison, not every decision criterion inside the model.
checks.title: Immediate sale is not preferred under base assumptions

checks.finding: strategy_renew charges re-let downtime and capital at expiry. It may describe expiry/re-letting risk, but it is not a clean signed early extension with uninterrupted rent.
checks.title: S3 is not an early-renewal comparator

checks.finding: Immediate sale returns cap-rated proceeds less assumed friction. The code has no owner tax basis, debt payoff, income-tax calculation, replacement-asset return, or reinvestment-risk stream. R multiples cannot be presented as personal wealth outcomes.
checks.title: This is not an after-tax wealth model

checks.finding: Tenant non-renewal, catastrophe probability and loss share, scenario weights, cap rates, downtime, capital costs and alternative-use value are declared assumptions. Regional hazard data do not calibrate parcel damage or closure probabilities.
checks.title: Probability inputs are assumptions

counterfactual.method: For S3 only, use raw strategy PV followed by the existing catastrophe adjustment; omit tenant_survival_adjust. Leave every other strategy and every other input unchanged.
